releaseNotes:
v1.3.0 - Security & Reliability Hardening
- Fixed 50+ security vulnerabilities identified in comprehensive audit
- Added service-layer input validation and bounds checking
- Added AI prompt injection protection (CRIT-03)
- Hardened monitoring settings with enforced safe bounds (HIGH-03)
- Fixed race conditions in AppUsage tracking (CRIT-08)
- Added screenshot size and format validation (CRIT-11)
- Improved session management - invalidate on password change (HIGH-07)
- Added email validation on user creation (MED-18)
- Enhanced encryption service with proper key disposal (HIGH-10)
- Protected against clock manipulation in activity tracking
- Added demo data seeder protection for production builds (CRIT-13)
- Fixed SuperAdmin seeding race condition (HIGH-11)
- Improved .gitignore with secret file exclusions (CRIT-10)
- Sanitized PAT tokens from error logs (HIGH-09)
